cohort: 29 women with histologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum treated at two specialized centers in Colombia and Indonesia, initially managed in resource-poor settings
finding: Undiagnosed placenta accreta spectrum in resource-poor settings was associated with high maternal mortality, and open-close abdominal surgery or leaving the placenta in situ appeared to be the safest initial management options.
mod_finding: The study examined outcomes of undiagnosed placenta accreta spectrum and found that open-close abdominal surgery or leaving the placenta in situ might be the safest options in resource-poor settings.
